title: Recent advances in first-row transition metal clusters for photocatalytic water splitting
claim: Changing the heteroatom of an otherwise analogous cobalt–tungstate POM can change visible-light-driven water-oxidation activity.
explanation: A four-member X-centered Co-POM series with X = Si, Ge, P, or As showed different activities; the Ge-centered member was reported as the most active of the series.
scope: The isostructural X-centered cobalt–tungstate POM series.
caveats: A corrupted comparison symbol in the Markdown prevents a confident full ordering of the P- and Si-centered members.
